tasks_completed.description: Created detailViewStore.ts Zustand store for inline detail view state
tasks_completed.rationale: Provides a simple isOpen/messageId store to coordinate between ToolView (opener) and SessionView (renderer) without router navigation

tasks_completed.description: Modified ToolView.tsx to use detailViewStore on desktop instead of router.push
tasks_completed.changes: On desktop (width >= 901), clicking a tool title calls openDetail(messageId) instead of router.push(). On mobile (width < 901), keeps existing router.push() behavior. Removed closeSidebar() call — the whole point is keeping the sidebar open. Extracted handlePress logic into useToolPress() helper function.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause was router.push() pushing a new Stack screen that replaced SessionView entirely, hiding the right sidebar

tasks_completed.description: Modified SessionView.tsx to render inline detail view when detailViewStore.isOpen is true
tasks_completed.changes: Added InlineDetailView and InlineDetailHeader components. SessionMainContent now checks detailIsOpen — if true, renders InlineDetailView (back button + ToolHeader + ToolFullView) instead of ChatList. Detail view auto-closes on session switch via useEffect in useSessionViewInnerState. Added findInChildren() for recursive message lookup (same as [messageId].tsx).
tasks_completed.rationale: Renders tool detail in the middle panel area while keeping RightSidebar visible in the flex row layout

git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: ToolView.handlePress used router.push() to navigate to [messageId].tsx Stack screen, which replaced the SessionView entirely including the right sidebar
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: On desktop, bypass router navigation entirely. Use a Zustand store to signal SessionMainContent to render ToolFullView inline, keeping the flex row layout with RightSidebar intact

dev.qa_notes: Verify on desktop (width >= 901): 1) Click a tool title in sidebar -> detail view renders in middle area, sidebar stays open. 2) Click back arrow -> returns to chat list. 3) Switch sessions -> detail view closes automatically. 4) On mobile (width < 901): clicking tool title still pushes Stack screen as before.
implementation_notes: The [messageId].tsx Stack screen is preserved for mobile navigation and direct URL access
ToolView.tsx no longer calls closeSidebar() on desktop — this was the wrong approach that the original code used
The InlineDetailView uses the same ToolFullView component as [messageId].tsx for consistent rendering

tdd_skip_reason: Pure UI navigation/layout change — not programmatically testable without browser rendering. QA must verify via Playwright.
